title: DRW-15, DRW-40, DRB-1, DRB-2 - Deesys Winding Type Current Transformer 1.15 kV
range_short_desc: Wound primary current transformer for metering
description: Deesys winding (wound primary) type current transformers rated up to 1.15 kV, for metering and watt-hour meter duty. DRW models are terminal type for low primary currents (5–30 A); DRB models are busbar type covering 40–500 A. Mounting direction changeable through 90°.

feature_groups.title: Main Feature
items: Colour: brown; case: ABS non-flammable resin; mould: polyester

rows: DRW-15 : primary 5–30 A, burden 15 VA, class 1.0 %, terminal type, weight 0.70 kg
DRB-1 : primary 40–150 / 200–300 / 400–500 A, burden 15 VA, class 1.0 %, busbar type, weight 0.85 kg
DRW-40 : primary 5–30 A, burden 40 VA, class 1.0 %, terminal type, weight 1.0 kg
DRB-2 : primary 40–150 / 200–300 / 400–500 A, burden 40 VA, class 1.0 %, busbar type, weight 1.2 kg
